release_notes: Fix release for 0.9.6.0. IMPORTANT: in 0.9.6.0 outbound S2S postbacks were queued but never delivered unless the delivery cron was installed by hand — after updating, open Settings -> Automation -> Postback queue and click 'Install delivery cron'. Queued postbacks are then delivered automatically. Also fixed: the S2S log showed every postback as an error, rows abandoned by a crashed worker were stuck forever, the retry ladder stopped one step short of 24h, re-syncing Facebook/Google Ads spend for the current day was discarded as a duplicate (today's cost stayed frozen at the first sync), cloaking sensitivity 'medium' behaved identically to 'high', and the SSRF re-check before delivery could be bypassed by an IP-literal host. New: the optional JS fingerprint check for cloaking that 0.9.6.0's notes promised.
